improvement.conclusion: Under the shared downstream compliance checker, Ours achieves higher Precision, Recall, and F1 than the Sun baseline on the current evaluation benchmark.
improvement.secondary_conclusion: Ours improves overall F1 by approximately 8.83 percentage points over Sun.

limitations: The current results are obtained on the constructed evaluation benchmark used during method development.
Final unseen benchmark/Gold packet is not constructed; only source-only candidate requirements remain.
No Ours Stage-2 predictions exist for unseen candidate requirements; explicit API authorization is required.
Ours Stage-2 A_r lacks a distinct process endpoint for R5-D-01/R5-D-02, so order recall is limited there.
R5-S7-T1/R5-S8-T1 are source action-action relations but their second endpoints are absent from both frozen Stage-2 A_r records.
Actor unknown remains material for Sun due to Definition 6 action-bound coverage; Definition 6 was intentionally not changed.
Missing-action precision remains limited by extra/fragment Stage-2 actions; no second action-scope revision was applied.
No formal significance test was performed; no p-value, confidence interval, or significance star is claimed.

replacement_policy.replacement_eligibility: Replacement eligibility depends on methodological strength, not whether the new F1 is numerically higher.
replacement_policy.if_final_unseen_evaluation_not_completed: If the user/advisor accepts the current evaluation design, this provisional Table 3 may become the submission Table 3; the data values themselves must not change.
replacement_policy.numerical_comparison_clause: If a legitimate unseen final evaluation yields Sun F1 = 0.60 and Ours F1 = 0.58, it must not be hidden in favor of this result; the current result may continue to be reported as a development benchmark result.

paper_facing.recommended_caption: Performance comparison on downstream compliance checking.

paper_facing.results_paragraph: Table X reports the downstream compliance-checking performance of Sun and our method under the same checking pipeline. Our method achieves a precision of 0.4393, recall of 0.6812, and F1-score of 0.5341, compared with 0.3814, 0.5362, and 0.4458 for Sun, respectively. This corresponds to an absolute F1 improvement of 0.0883.
paper_facing.breakdown_sentence: The improvement is mainly associated with better performance on missing-action and incorrect-actor cases, while the two methods obtain the same F1 on the evaluated out-of-order cases.
paper_facing.caveat: The current results are obtained on the constructed evaluation benchmark used during method development. A separately frozen unseen evaluation may replace this result if completed before submission.
paper_facing.allowed_conclusion: Under the shared downstream compliance checker, Ours achieves higher Precision, Recall, and F1 than the Sun baseline on the current evaluation benchmark.
